newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish police find new drug smuggling tactic.
newsitem.headline: Spanish police find new drug smuggling tactic.

text.p: Spanish police said on Tuesday they had seized 16 kg (35 lb) of cocaine and arrested a man in a crackdown on a new drug-smuggling tactic.
The drugs were hidden in two packages originally sent from Spain to Colombia and returned apparently due to an incorrect address.
Police arrested the man after he came to a Madrid post office to pick up the returned packages, which police believe had been opened, filled with drugs and then sent back to Spain.

"The drug-smuggling groups are always thinking up new ways to introduce drugs into our country ...and one novel practice is sending parcels to Colombia which are later returned on the pretext that the address is inaccurate," police said in a statement.
